name: Crawling Claw Swarm
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
description: Emerging from the shadowed crevices of the Vaultlands' moss-clad stones, the Crawling Claw Swarm is a chilling manifestation of restless death. This mass of severed, pale hands writhes and scrabbles with unnatural coordination, the fingers clawing desperately at anything within reach. Each claw is mottled with grime and faint traces of ancient runic scars hinting at a forgotten curse binding them together. The swarm moves with a sickening rustle, the sound of rattling bones and scraping nails echoing faintly through the damp, mist-laden air. As it advances, a cold draft seems to follow, carrying a whisper of mournful wails and the faint scent of decayed flesh. The claws occasionally clutch at the moss and stone, leaving shallow gouges that glow faintly under moonlight or torchlight, as if the very earth recoils from their touch. This swarm is relentless and driven by a malevolent intelligence--an echo of tormented souls denied rest, condemned to drag themselves endlessly through the catacombs and threshold ruins. In the gloom beneath the Stonewrought Threshold and the Ancestral Catacombs, the Crawling Claw Swarm is a haunting reminder that some remnants of the past refuse to stay buried.
